One of the best MMORPGs I've ever played in terms of raid content and PvP balance (IMO). Sadly, even the best PvP/PvE experience can be ruined by a poorly managed game. I still miss this game back when it was just starting out!

[b]In overall, the game's main audience are "hardcore gamers", as cringe as it sounds and there is nothing wrong with that. Moment to moment gameplay is as good as it gets, and for me, the biggest win. It's the best feeling game I've ever played.[/b]

[b]Short version:[/b] I can recommend the game to anyone, who likes really, REALLY good combat mechanics, especially in ARPGs. Coming from league (which feels amazing to play and yes it's not an ARPG) I can wholeheartedly say, that this game feels even better. The progression feels extremely meaningful and it's a great linear to exponential curve towards the current endgame. Once you understand the systems ingame, it's a joy to tinker around, eventough you will most likely stick to your meta builds. Do not expect to meet anyone along your early game journey (level 1-50 and until ilvl 1250, probably 1430 at the time of this writing), the endgame content is truly peak content in general gaming terms.

[b]General advice to beginners:[/b] You're new to the game? Look, it's a korean p2w game, you have to do your research. This is not your fault, it's just how the core game is designed. Alot of its problems stems from being a p2w game. I would've gladly paid a monthly fee to have a much better game experience, but we can't change that, can we. During your leveling 1-50 hours enjoy the game, if you have a friend to bring along, that'll be great. Nothing really matters, equip whatever comes along until you reach ilvl 1250 currently. Most dungeons will be a solo experience (at least the game gives you the option of doing that) since the game lacks players. Sadly don't expect to meet people until the endgame, where the grind really begins. Join a relevant discord community (People will gladly help you out there to find groups for raids, guardians and all other content. You will receive help for building your character and most importantly, you will find a community that is mostly nice in comparison to the toxic moshpit ingame. Again, not your fault you gotta do this, but I can wholeheartedly recommend this after playing for almost a year without it. It's a night and day difference. You might also make some friends along the way. Take whatever the game throws at you and store it until you understand the concept of them. We haven't touched gems or engravings until it was absolutely necessary for example. And why not touch them? Remember, it's f2p p2w, use the free ressources you get and don't waste them. Until you feel comfortable with the mechanics and intricacies at least. If you don't know what to do with something, do some google research and maybe ask on discord before you "waste" it. Get your daily login bonuses. The game throws alot at you as a f2p and it can feel overwhelming. Just store it and use it whenever you feel ready for it. That's how we played and honestly we didn't pay for anything except for the occasional Lost Ark Pass (comparable to any battle pass). Take it step by step and most systems will make sense. And just make sure to ask, we've all been there and it will save you some frustration. The game could do this better, but it is what it is. For class build guides I can recommened the community guides (just google "lost ark community guide for XXXX class") and some Google Doc should pop up (or something with a .nexus domain).

[b]Our experience:[/b]
I keep talking about "us" - I'm married, 30yo, playing this game exclusively with my wife since launch. We've taken a break from October 2022 to June 2023 due to burning out ingame. This game demands alot of your time- over time. We used to play 6 characters to maximize gold income, but doing all those daily chores, all those weeklies, all those raids every week, all that content- just took too much time and wasn't fun anymore. However, after half a year of trying a bunch of other MMO(RPG)'s, we came back, because honestly they all suck aswell. At least in gameplay terms. It's relevant that I'm married because I'm socially "maxed out" already, I don't feel the need for socializing much and MMO's have their focus (usually) less on gameplay and more on social features. Lost Ark however, has the priorities exactly right for us: It's all about the game(play). The lore is fine, it has its momoments, but it's extremely cliché and forgettable for the most part. The raids (with their respective difficulties) are by far the most satisfying thing I've ever experienced in gaming- ever. I've had some clutch matches in league, that also drops the good hormones, but finally making a raid with a bunch of randoms that have been struggling aswell for days- now that's absolutely peak gaming right there. Especially if you're all at the same level, mostly clueless and trying to just make it. This is the most fun part of the game.

Less fun is repeating exactly that. I felt alot of times that those kinds of content shouldn't be repeatable so often and my review would've been very different half a year ago- which brings me to the current changes: I'm extremely happy about the recent changes. The developers have already halved the homework for the most part, are actively working on the repetitiveness of the game and are already removing parts of the game, that shouldn't be in there and are turning some raids into biweekly content, which is VERY GOOD. They gotta work on content and alternative routes for people that aren't into hardcore raiding (however this is a raid focused game- what are you doing here? Trying to fish your way into the endgame?). The thing is IF you cut the annoying parts out of the game and remove most p2w f2p elements, there's not much "game" left. If you don't do your daily chores and less raids and only have one character- what is left in the game? Not much. There's alot of potential for other activities and they're mostly fleshed out (e.g. wood cutting was even fun for us? Up to 4 people can fell a tree wtf??? There's even special animations for that and everything? And it's mostly IRRELEVANT and UNDERUTILIZED???), however they lack purpose. Alot of activities in this game lack significant purpose.

This game is such a double edged sword in every way: The fact, that the game is somewhat forcing you into playing more than 1 character, which is ass for some, but for me I find it fun and refreshing to play and try out different classes, understand how they work and understand why they do certain things in raids. Play a support class, ACTUALLY understand how they work instead of guessing. The game is SO difficult and raid focused, yet only BECAUSE of this it feels satisfying to finish one, yet so frustrating to repeat it often. If they would split their attention to other things, would that result in mediocre raids? I could name a ton of other things, but these are two important things to us.

[i]Great core gameplay, mediocre plot, somewhat complicated systems (just because there are many, none of them are particularly complex), mostly impatient ingame playerbase, reliance on outside sources and a big, fun to some, unfun to others, grindy game.[/i]

[b]The future was looking very grim for LOA, but currently there's a beacon of hope. I honestly hope they keep going like this.[/b]

[b]FAIR WARNING, THIS IS VERY LONG, AND IT EXPLAINS A LARGE PORTION OF THE CHANGES MADE TO OUR VERSION OF LOST ARK, AS WELL AS MY OPINION ON THE GAME ON TOP. [/b]

Allow me to preface this by saying that Lost Ark is an Amazing (yes, with capital A), game. In fact, I encourage you to try it out regardless of the mutilation inflicted upon it - you will not regret it. This review refers only, AND ONLY, to Amazon's version of the game. If I were reviewing the Korean or Russian client I'd be giving it the highest score possible on every website, and even beyond that. It's a product of love, full of soul and showing the dedication of the Korean dev team which crafted it. It's a one of a kind experience which cannot be compared to any other game purely due to how unique it is. I played this game on RU for two years (a little over), and have nearly 40 hours as a plat founder on West. The gameplay is the literal nectar of the gods, the combat bordering flawless. It's one of the few games of today which are an actual "joy" and true pleasure to play, at least in my opinion. The aesthetics of the original, the soul of the game, the feel of it - everything is created with utmost love and care, by people who treasure their creation and want it to be the best it possibly can be - and it shows.

Now, why I give this a negative review? Well, that's simple. AGS took it upon themselves to force "westernization" (let's call them as such for the sake of argument, bear with me) changes into this version of the game. Changes which are outright downgrades rather than positives and which, to my knowledge, no one asked for. 

[h1] EDIT: As of today, further censorship (direct lies from AGS)  has been exposed. The promise of nothing else being censored is false, Queen Azena (white form) is censored in our version. And that's just one of the things I found out. Not just censorship, but potentially false advertisement as well. [/h1]

[h1]STARTING OUTFITS CENSORSHIP:[/h1]
For little to no reason, starter outfits have been censored and uglified (only for female characters of course). Every single starter outfit has been swapped out for a full body cover, often a ridiculously ugly one as in the case of the Martial Artist. From a woman practising martial arts she, apparently, turned into a mercenary straight out of Lion's Landing in GoT, with some brown, full body leathers covering her. It's actually cringe to even look at, because not only is it there with the evident intention to just censor the female body, not only does it look like a RIDICULOUSLY low quality reskin (it legit sticks out like a sore thumb and doesn't fit the game aesthetic at all), but they didn't even bother matching the class fantasy - that's how low effort it is.

[h1]TRANSLATIONS KR to EN:[/h1]
This is perhaps the one thing which pisses me off most. Comparing translations from KR and RU reveals that many quests which had a sexual theme or a not-very-politically-correct topic such as guards discussing going to brothels and dwarves talking about dying in their beds with elf girls next to them have been changed to much less "problematic", ahem, topics for our version - which often make zero sense, by the way, and simply sound watered down and diluted. Not only that, but many of the translations which aren't directly "toned down" for """"obvious"""" western sensitivities, simply make almost no sense in regards to the situation. They feel soulless, rushed and without even the slightest feel or effort to them. The voice actors sound half-assed most of the time, voices don't match, many voice lines are outright missing. The English used is utmost basic and stripped down of any fantasy or "epic", realistic feel to it. Even the Russian translators made everything sound more epic than this - considerably so. There are numerous, numerous examples of quests being watered down in order to be more "politically correct" and ensure they don't offend anyone, with the sense of some of them entirely changed, lines removed. Many of the side stories have been literally sterilized, and not only sterilized, but also done so in a ridiculously lazy way which immediately breaks immersion and puts a person paying attention to the lore and story off.

And not only that, but even the quests which aren't "problematic" have been skimmed through. Terrible translations often being completely inaccurate or misrepresenting the NPC or the situation, basic and bland. I don't know who translated this game, but the Russians translating from Korean have done unironically a 10 times better job. Entire lines of your character and choices have been stripped. Another example, the martial arts tournament in anich (Anikka here), the guy you speak to before every fight begins has a specific line and discussion for every single different fighter before you face them and he speaks to you about it before the fight. Here, he just repeats the same thing over and over again. "SHOW US WHAT YOU"RE CAPABLE OF. (???)

[h1]BLACKWASHING / DELETING PRESETS:[/h1]
And even further, Asian presets in the character creator have been outright deleted, only to be replaced by presets of black characters which seem to, for most classes, hold an almost 50 / 50 ratio with the whites (?), with little to no Asian presets whatsoever left. Not only this, but already well-established quest NPCs from the other versions of the game have had their skin color altered just for the sake of some sort of strange, quota fitting diversity to have half of the population of Arkesia look black. Blackwashing or whatever it is you call it. This normally wouldn't be an issue if not for the point about the asian presets and what I've written in the paragraph below. "Diversity" is not necessarily a bad thing, but when it's taken THIS far, it starts looking out of place. I guess swapping asian for blacks is fine as far as diversity is concerned?

At first I didn't mind the blackwashing (diversity of skin color for the west actually makes sense, even to purists), but then I had a deeper look. There are places which unironically have a 80% black NPC ratio, it's like Arkesia turned into Africa overnight. Go to Lakebar, there are 2-3 white NPCs and everyone else is black (?).  It's actually bordering on the insanity in some places, it looks literally unnatural and even a person who has never played Lost Ark in the other regions can see something is off and call it out, simply because it looks so out of place with the amount of black NPCs around. Some locations have had their asians / whites exterminated apparently? Not only this, but the blackwashing itself is done in extremely poor and lazy fashion - black skin literally slapped on NPCs with asian or Caucasian facial features, making the comedic tragedy even deeper.

No amount of amazing gameplay can carry a game if you strip away it's soul, I'm sorry. It's very clear that AGS aim to just draw in people who ignore everything else in the game and do nothing but spam chaos dungeons, guardian and legion raids in end game. And there is just SO MUCH more to the actual game than this. Lost Ark West has been stripped down of any flavor, with the excuse of "GaMePlay iS ThE SaME". A soulless reskin.

[b] There are many more alterations, but I simply can't fit them in the review due to the limit.

I have never seen a more heavily-handed altered eastern game deployed in the west. Translations are a poor and soulless, politically correct, lazy mess. Almost everything related to localization is a severe downgrade in comparison to the original. It screams of low effort and questionable politics injected in it.
